table action_items: CREATE TABLE action_items ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, meeting_id TEXT REFERENCES meetings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, task TEXT NOT NULL, owner TEXT, due TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', review_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', reviewed_at TEXT, source_timestamp REAL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')), completed_at TEXT, delegated_at TEXT, source_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'meeting', source_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' )

trigger artifacts_memory_ad: CREATE TRIGGER artifacts_memory_ad AFTER DELETE ON artifacts BEGIN DELETE FROM artifacts_memory_fts WHERE source_id=OLD.id; END
trigger artifacts_memory_ai: CREATE TRIGGER artifacts_memory_ai AFTER INSERT ON artifacts BEGIN INSERT INTO artifacts_memory_fts(source_id,title,body_markdown) VALUES(NEW.id,NEW.title,NEW.body_markdown); END
trigger artifacts_memory_au: CREATE TRIGGER artifacts_memory_au AFTER UPDATE ON artifacts BEGIN DELETE FROM artifacts_memory_fts WHERE source_id=OLD.id; INSERT INTO artifacts_memory_fts(source_id,title,body_markdown) VALUES(NEW.id,NEW.title,NEW.body_markdown); END
trigger decisions_memory_ad: CREATE TRIGGER decisions_memory_ad AFTER DELETE ON decisions BEGIN DELETE FROM decisions_memory_fts WHERE source_id=OLD.id; END
trigger decisions_memory_ai: CREATE TRIGGER decisions_memory_ai AFTER INSERT ON decisions WHEN NEW.deleted = 0 AND NEW.source_state = 'linked' BEGIN INSERT INTO decisions_memory_fts(source_id,text,rationale) VALUES(NEW.id,NEW.text,COALESCE(NEW.rationale,'')); END
trigger decisions_memory_au: CREATE TRIGGER decisions_memory_au AFTER UPDATE ON decisions BEGIN DELETE FROM decisions_memory_fts WHERE source_id=OLD.id; INSERT INTO decisions_memory_fts(source_id,text,rationale) SELECT NEW.id,NEW.text,COALESCE(NEW.rationale,'') WHERE NEW.deleted=0 AND NEW.source_state='linked'; END
trigger decisions_sever_meeting_source: CREATE TRIGGER decisions_sever_meeting_source AFTER DELETE ON meetings BEGIN UPDATE decisions SET source_state = 'source_deleted', updated_at = datetime('now'), last_modified = datetime('now') WHERE source_meeting_id = OLD.id AND deleted = 0; END

trigger inference_route_plan_preflight_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER inference_route_plan_preflight_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON inference_route_plan_preflight_evidence BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable inference route preflight evidence'); END
trigger inference_route_plan_preflight_no_update: CREATE TRIGGER inference_route_plan_preflight_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON inference_route_plan_preflight_evidence BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable inference route preflight evidence'); END
trigger inference_route_plan_principal_evidence_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER inference_route_plan_principal_evidence_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON inference_route_plan_principal_evidence BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable inference route principal evidence'); END
trigger inference_route_plan_principal_evidence_no_update: CREATE TRIGGER inference_route_plan_principal_evidence_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON inference_route_plan_principal_evidence BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable inference route principal evidence'); END
trigger intel_job_attempts_append_only_update: CREATE TRIGGER intel_job_attempts_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON intel_job_attempts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'intel job attempts are append-only'); END
trigger intel_jobs_immutable_descriptor: CREATE TRIGGER intel_jobs_immutable_descriptor BEFORE UPDATE OF job_id, meeting_id, transcript_hash, displaced_work, work_descriptor_sha256 ON intel_jobs WHEN OLD.work_descriptor_sha256 != '' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'intel job descriptor is immutable'); END
trigger kernel_inference_receipt_attestations_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER kernel_inference_receipt_attestations_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON kernel_inference_receipt_attestations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable kernel inference receipt attestation'); END
trigger kernel_inference_receipt_attestations_no_update: CREATE TRIGGER kernel_inference_receipt_attestations_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON kernel_inference_receipt_attestations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable kernel inference receipt attestation'); END
trigger kernel_parent_publication_blocks_transition: CREATE TRIGGER kernel_parent_publication_blocks_transition BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON kernel_parent_runs WHEN OLD.publication_claim_id != '' AND NEW.state != OLD.state AND NEW.publication_claim_id = OLD.publication_claim_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'kernel_parent_publication_in_progress'); END
trigger kernel_parent_publication_blocks_warrant_revocation: CREATE TRIGGER kernel_parent_publication_blocks_warrant_revocation BEFORE UPDATE OF warrant_revoked ON kernel_operations WHEN OLD.warrant_revoked = 0 AND NEW.warrant_revoked = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kernel_parent_runs p WHERE p.operation_id = OLD.operation_id AND p.publication_claim_id != '' ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'kernel_parent_publication_in_progress'); END
trigger notes_memory_ad: CREATE TRIGGER notes_memory_ad AFTER DELETE ON notes BEGIN DELETE FROM notes_memory_fts WHERE source_id=OLD.id; END
trigger notes_memory_ai: CREATE TRIGGER notes_memory_ai AFTER INSERT ON notes WHEN NEW.deleted = 0 BEGIN INSERT INTO notes_memory_fts(source_id,title,body_markdown) VALUES(NEW.id,NEW.title,NEW.body_markdown); END
trigger notes_memory_au: CREATE TRIGGER notes_memory_au AFTER UPDATE ON notes BEGIN DELETE FROM notes_memory_fts WHERE source_id=OLD.id; INSERT INTO notes_memory_fts(source_id,title,body_markdown) SELECT NEW.id,NEW.title,NEW.body_markdown WHERE NEW.deleted=0; END
trigger segments_ad: CREATE TRIGGER segments_ad AFTER DELETE ON segments BEGIN INSERT INTO segments_fts(segments_fts, rowid, text, speaker) VALUES('delete', OLD.id, OLD.text, OLD.speaker); END
trigger segments_ai: CREATE TRIGGER segments_ai AFTER INSERT ON segments BEGIN INSERT INTO segments_fts(rowid, text, speaker) VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.text, NEW.speaker); END
trigger segments_au: CREATE TRIGGER segments_au AFTER UPDATE ON segments BEGIN INSERT INTO segments_fts(segments_fts, rowid, text, speaker) VALUES('delete', OLD.id, OLD.text, OLD.speaker); INSERT INTO segments_fts(rowid, text, speaker) VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.text, NEW.speaker); END
trigger thread_messages_fts_ad: CREATE TRIGGER thread_messages_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON thread_message_parts WHEN OLD.text IS NOT NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO thread_messages_fts(thread_messages_fts, rowid, text) VALUES('delete', OLD.rowid, OLD.text); END
trigger thread_messages_fts_ai: CREATE TRIGGER thread_messages_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON thread_message_parts WHEN NEW.text IS NOT NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO thread_messages_fts(rowid, text) SELECT NEW.rowid, NEW.text WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM thread_messages WHERE id = NEW.message_id AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL ); END
trigger thread_messages_fts_au: CREATE TRIGGER thread_messages_fts_au AFTER UPDATE OF text ON thread_message_parts BEGIN INSERT INTO thread_messages_fts(thread_messages_fts, rowid, text) SELECT 'delete', OLD.rowid, OLD.text WHERE OLD.text IS NOT NULL; INSERT INTO thread_messages_fts(rowid, text) SELECT NEW.rowid, NEW.text WHERE NEW.text IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM thread_messages WHERE id = NEW.message_id AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL ); END
trigger thread_messages_fts_msg_soft_delete: CREATE TRIGGER thread_messages_fts_msg_soft_delete AFTER UPDATE OF deleted_at ON thread_messages WHEN NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND OLD.deleted_at IS NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO thread_messages_fts(thread_messages_fts, rowid, text) SELECT 'delete', p.rowid, p.text FROM thread_message_parts p WHERE p.message_id = NEW.id AND p.text IS NOT NULL; END
trigger tool_turn_commands_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER tool_turn_commands_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON tool_turn_commands BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable tool turn command'); END
trigger tool_turn_commands_no_update: CREATE TRIGGER tool_turn_commands_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON tool_turn_commands BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable tool turn command'); END
trigger tool_turn_effect_children_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER tool_turn_effect_children_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON tool_turn_effect_children BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable tool turn effect child'); END
trigger tool_turn_effect_children_no_update: CREATE TRIGGER tool_turn_effect_children_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON tool_turn_effect_children WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.turn_id IS NOT OLD.turn_id OR NEW.tool_call_id IS NOT OLD.tool_call_id OR NEW.broker_child_id IS NOT OLD.broker_child_id OR NEW.owner_intent_receipt_ref IS NOT OLD.owner_intent_receipt_ref OR NEW.policy_receipt_ref IS NOT OLD.policy_receipt_ref OR OLD.state != 'reserved' OR NEW.state NOT IN ('adopted','indeterminate','refused') OR (NEW.state != 'adopted' AND (NEW.adopted_receipt_id != '' OR NEW.result_sha256 != '')) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable tool turn effect child'); END
trigger tool_turn_model_steps_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER tool_turn_model_steps_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON tool_turn_model_steps BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable tool turn model step'); END
trigger tool_turn_model_steps_no_update: CREATE TRIGGER tool_turn_model_steps_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON tool_turn_model_steps WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.turn_id IS NOT OLD.turn_id OR NEW.ordinal IS NOT OLD.ordinal OR NEW.operation_request_plan_id IS NOT OLD.operation_request_plan_id OR NEW.operation_request_plan_sha256 IS NOT OLD.operation_request_plan_sha256 OR NEW.lease_sha256 IS NOT OLD.lease_sha256 OR NEW.request_material_ref IS NOT OLD.request_material_ref OR (OLD.route_execution_id != '' AND NEW.route_execution_id IS NOT OLD.route_execution_id) OR (OLD.child_receipt_id != '' AND NEW.child_receipt_id IS NOT OLD.child_receipt_id) OR (OLD.result_sha256 != '' AND NEW.result_sha256 IS NOT OLD.result_sha256) OR OLD.state NOT IN ('reserved','running') OR (OLD.state='reserved' AND NEW.state NOT IN ('running','indeterminate')) OR (OLD.state='running' AND NEW.state NOT IN ('receipted','failed','indeterminate')) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable tool turn model step'); END
trigger tool_turn_transitions_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER tool_turn_transitions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON tool_turn_transitions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable tool turn transition'); END
trigger tool_turn_transitions_no_update: CREATE TRIGGER tool_turn_transitions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON tool_turn_transitions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable tool turn transition'); END
trigger turn_capability_leases_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER turn_capability_leases_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON turn_capability_leases BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable turn capability lease'); END
